items.q: What is a phone calling agent?
items.a: A phone calling agent is an AI agent that makes or answers phone calls, for example for sales, renewals, collections, scheduling or support.

items.q: How do you test an AI calling agent?
items.a: TestMu AI uses AI evaluators that answer or place calls with your agent, follow personas and score every call on business and quality metrics.
First-call resolution, CSAT, transcription accuracy, containment rate and 30+ other quality metrics.
Yes. Checks can confirm required disclosures and consent language on every call.

items.q: Is this different from IVR testing?
items.a: Yes. IVR testing focuses on menu systems with key presses. Calling agent testing focuses on conversational AI agents, inbound and outbound.
